items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: He'd be right in there, pitch 18 innings. Buck Leonard, and, and, and, and, to name a few.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. They, they got a kick out of them.

That's right. One of the real great pitches they had, it was a fella named Joe Pato. And, Pato, I think it's a P-E-R-D-O, I'm sure that's how you spell it. The old Thomas would remember that name. Mm-hmm. He, he would stop and, and play baseball with the kids, and with this old rag ball, and then leave them, go to Crescent Stalk Park, and pitch 18 innings against the great, great ball players. Mm-hmm. Buck Leonard, and, and, and, and, to name a few. Yeah. He'd be right in there, pitch 18 innings.
Do you remember, you said the Crescent Starks?
